phase1.code:
# Polish and Submit — Final touches

print("=== Python-chan's Course 1 Complete! ===\n")

# Review checklist for the final project
review = {
    "Code Quality": [
        "Follow PEP 8 style",
        "Clear variable names",
        "Proper indentation",
        "Comments and docstrings"
    ],
    "Functionality": [
        "All features working",
        "Error handling",
        "Save/Load system",
        "Game loop complete"
    ],
    "OOP Concepts": [
        "Classes and objects",
        "Inheritance (if used)",
        "Encapsulation",
        "Polymorphism"
    ],
    "Python Features": [
        "File I/O",
        "JSON serialization",
        "Random module",
        "Exception handling",
        "Collections"
    ]
}

print("Final Project Checklist:")
for category, items in review.items():
    print(f"\n{category}:")
    for item in items:
        print(f"  ✅ {item}")

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("🎉 CONGRATULATIONS! 🎉")
print("=" * 50)
print("\nYou've completed Python-chan's Course 1!")
print("\nWhat you've learned:")
print("  ✅ Python fundamentals")
print("  ✅ Control flow and functions")
print("  ✅ Collections (lists, dicts, sets)")
print("  ✅ File handling and errors")
print("  ✅ Object-oriented programming")
print("  ✅ Testing and debugging")
print("  ✅ Built a complete CLI game")

print("\nNext steps:")
print("  1. Polish your game with extra features")
print("  2. Continue to Course 2: Data Science")
print("  3. Build more projects")
print("  4. Share your game with others")

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("Python-chan says:")
print('  "You did it! I knew you could."')
print('  "Python is now your friend."')
print('  "Go build amazing things! 🐍"')
print("=" * 50)
